Commentary.Commentary: The Lankans have their work cut out. They won't be looking at the target, or the overs remaining, but just try and bat out hour by hour and session by session. Perhaps looking for survival should not be the aim. Just play normal cricket, or at least TRY TO. They need not look far for an inspiration. Recently Pakistan gave Australia some shivers, almost chasing down an improbable target of 490. Stay tuned.

A very good batting scorecard for the hosts. Stephen Cook got back-to-back centuries in Tests while Elgar, Amla, Faf and de Kock just made hay while the sun shone. The visitors were nowhere near what they were in the first innings with the ball and were already looking deflated from the very first ball.

So just 10.5 overs bowled this morning and the Proteas have declared. The runs would never have been an issue, the time factor would have. In all, the Proteas have a minimum of 183 overs to bowl Sri Lanka out - 85 today and 98 tomorrow. Should the Lankans face so many overs and survive, I daresay, we will see the biggest successful run chase in Test history.

OUT! DECISION STANDS! Slightly flatter outside off, spinning in a touch, de Kock looks to sweep but misses it completely and gets rapped up on the front pad. The ball then goes in the hands of Mathews at first slip. Herath starts appealing as soon as the ball hit the pad and the umpire raises his finger in agreement. De Kock however reviews it. The Snicko shows no edge but even if it was present he would have been out as Mathews had caught it. But there is no edge and we move on to the Ball Tracker. It shows that the impact is in line and is going on to hit the middle stump. The decision stands and de Kock has to walk back. The rest of the players also start walking back as du Plessis DECLARE with a LEAD OF 487 RUNS!
De Kock takes review after given out by the onfield umpire for an lbw decision.
Du Plessis gently pushes it to the widish mid on region and takes another single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

NOT OUT! DECISION STANDS! Served outside off, spinning in, de Kock shuffles across and looks to play it with the turn but misses and gets hit on the pads. Herath and co. appeal but it's turned down. After a discussion with Herath, Mathews opts to take the review. The Ball Tracker shows that the impact is in line but the ball is going on to clip the leg stump. Hence, the onfield decision stands!
Sri Lanka takes the review against de Kock for an lbw decision given not out!
Tossed up outside off, du Plessis clears his front leg and drives through covers for a single.
Full on middle and off, driven to mid on for a single.
The field is set deep and the Protea manages to run through for another single. This time through the leg side as du Plessis flicks it with the turn.
Full outside off, de Kock drives it through covers for another single.
Once again du Plessis flicks it with the turn towards mid-wicket for a single.
Spinning down leg, played with the turn through mid-wicket for a couple.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
De Kock places it in the gap at covers for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Spinning into the pads, tickled away on the leg side behind square for a single.
On middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
This time de Kock manages to connect his flick and gets a single for it.
Sliding into the pads with the arm, de Kock looks to flick but gets beaten by the variation.
Rangana Herath will bowl from the other end!
Sliding into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single. The lead is now 473!
FOUR! Inside out! Fullish delivery outside off, de Kock lofts it over covers for a boundary. There were 6 men on the off side but still managed to get the ball towards the fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On the pads, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Shortish delivery wide outside off, cut through point for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, de Kock drives it through covers. Finds the gap and the ball reaches the fence in a flash!
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA comes on to bowl!
FOUR! Creamed it! Once again it's full outside off, du Plessis leans into the cover drive beautifully and gains four runs for it.
Outside off, driven to mid off.
100-run partnership between de Kock and du Plessis!
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot. Perera at short cover makes a good stop, saving a couple of runs for his team. Two runs taken!
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
Full outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
9th Test fifty for du Plessis!
On the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for three runs. He too brings up his fifty with this.
Short and wide outside off, Quinton slaps it through covers for a couple.
Back of a length delivery, defended off the back foot.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock flashes his bat at it but misses.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock looks to cut it but only manages to get a faint bottom edge into the ground and towards the keeper.
Comes form around the wicket. Outside off, played to point.
7th test fifty for de Kock!
Full and wide outside off, de Kock gets across and slashes it through covers for a brace. De Kock continues his sublime form by bringing another half century.
Length delivery outside off, taped to point. De Silva fails to stop it and the batsmen take a couple.
This time du Plessis leaves it much closer from the body.
Outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Back of a length delivery outside off, du Plessis punches off the back foot through covers. Finds the gap and Kusal Perera giving it a chase does his best but can't prevent it from reaching the fence.
Length delivery outside off, Plessis pushes it towards point.
On the pads, flicked through the square leg region for a single.
OUCH! Fullish delivery around off, du Plessis presses forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto the groin area. He is in pain and shouts in agony!
Length delivery, angling across, de Kock shuffles and cuts it front of square on the off side for a single.
Back of a length delivery, played towards backward point. The gully fielder cuts it out and gives away no runs.
Length delivery, width on offer, de Kock plays it square of the wicket on the off side.
Length delivery angling away, defended off the back foot.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Outside off, pushed to covers.

Length delivery tapped to point and Faf calls him for a quick single. De Silva rushes towards the ball and looks to throw it on the dive but fails to hit the target. however, Faf was quick and had made his ground. Another quick single taken!
Once again full outside off, once again de Kock drives it. This time it's straight down the ground where Chameera does well to stop it in his follow through, diving to his right.
Full and wide outside off, de Kock leans into the drive but unfortunately it's straight at the man at short covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot on the off side. Yet another quick single. Excellent rotation of strike from these two!
Fullish delivery on off, defended late with a straight bat.
No ball! Full on leg, de Kock clips it with ease through square leg for a single. No ball signaled for overstepping. The replay shows that the decision was a touch harsh on Chameera!
Fullish delivery outside off, du Plessis covers his stumps and looks defend it from within the crease but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Straying on the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, fended with the angle near short leg for another cheeky single.
Outside off, left alone.
Leg bye! On the pads, de Kock looks to flick it but misses. The ball hits him on the pads and lands near the practice pitch beside. They run through for a quick leg bye!
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
SURANGA LAKMAL to continue from the other end.
Another leave by Faf.
Du Plessis covers his stumps and leaves the outside off delivery through to the keeper.
Outside off, left alone. After getting beaten on the first ball he faced today, Faf is being more careful.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
BEATEN! Length delivery outside off with a hint of away swing, Faf looks to reach out for it but gets beaten by the away movement.
Length delivery on middle, de Kock clips it through mid-wicket and runs through for a single. Runs straightaway!

The players are out in the middle. QUINTON DE KOCK and FAF DU PLESSIS take their place in the centre. Sri Lanka have straightaway opted for the second new ball. DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA to start the proceedings with the new ball and for the day.

Hello and a warm welcome to Day 4 of the first Test between South Africa and Sri Lanka. The hosts have taken a healthy lead of 432 runs in the third innings with Faf du Plessis and Quinton de Kock still in the middle. Now, the question is what total would Faf feel as a safe one before declaring. The weather will also play a factor in this decision, but the weather department predicts no rain for today but it would be overcast. The visitors also seem to be waiting for the same as it was seen from their body language. Let's see what we have in store today...
... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ...

So what next then? If the weather stays good for the next two days, then South Africa will look to bat for two sessions, rack up a lead close to 550 and then give their bowlers 4 sessions to take 10 wickets. However, if there is some issue with the weather, Faf might declare at Lunch. Join us at 1330 IST (0800 GMT) to see what happens as Day 4 unfolds. Before that, you can catch all the action from the second Australia-Pakistan Test. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

There seemed to be some life in the Lankans, when the Proteas suddenly lost 3/32 after Tea but then Chandimal missed a simple stumping chance of de Kock off Herath. De Kock and du Plessis have raised a quick 74-run stand and taken South Africa to a position from where they cannot lose. Or, SHOULD NOT lose.

Dean Elgar and Stephen Cook gave the Lankans a good batting coaching, adding 116 for the opening wicket. The former threw his wicket away while the latter got to his third century in 7 Tests. Then Amla came in and played a wonderful innings, although short, with the lead already swelling past 200. On the other hand, Duminy missed out on a big score when everyone was doing well.

End of a miserable day for the Lankans. They were 105 runs behind at stumps yesterday and this morning, could not add much with de Silva getting dismissed on the first ball. Vernon Philander got a well-deserved fifer and what followed after that, was a real drubbing.
No excitement. Just a mere push behind point for a single to end the day's proceedings. STUMPS ON DAY 3, SOUTH AFRICA LEAD BY 432 RUNS!
Last ball of the day... how about something exciting...
Fuller again, outside off once more, now QdK shoulders arms.
Full and outside off again, pushed straight to cover this time.
Full and outside off, Quinton comes forward and dead-bats it.
Landed around off, going away, tapped through the covers for a run. 350 COMES UP FOR SOUTH AFRICA.
Full and wide outside off, de Kock flays it through point for a single. The lead is now 430.
Last over of the day then... Can Sri Lanka get something out of it?
Landed around off, Faf goes back and punches it back to the bowler. Herath is done for the day.
Full and around off, Quinton comes forward and whips it through mid-wicket for another single. He too moves to 40, but from 46 balls.
Full and outside off, eased through cover-point for one. Moves to 40 from 53 balls. The stand is worth 70 from 84 balls.
Full and around off, pushed down to long on for a run.
Short and outside off, de Kock goes back to cut but is too close to the ball. Ends up getting a bit of a bottom edge, past first slip to third man. Two runs taken.
Full and around off, du Plessis stays leg side of the ball and drives it to long off for a single.
RANGANA HERATH to bowl the last over of the day from this particular end.
Outside off, fuller in length, placed through point for one.
Outside off, left alone.
Comes around the wicket to the left-hander, bowls an absolutely harmless delivery outside off, wide as well, de Kock punches it behind point for a run.
Landed around off again, du Plessis goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, left alone.
A short ball, pulled away for a single.
SURANGA LAKMAL to bowl a maximum of two more overs tonight. Mathews is seeking an inspiration before stumps.
On middle and leg, tucked through backward square leg for another single.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Landed on off, worked through mid-wicket for three runs.

FOUR! Landed outside off, Quinton goes back and cuts it behind point. Won't go all the way to the fence and the batsmen take three as the fielder gets to the ball and slides to pull the back in. But it is referred upstairs and the replays show that while doing so, his right foot was touching the ropes. De Kock moves to 30.
Full and outside off, de Kock lunges and defends.
Full and outside off, worked through mid-wicket for a single. The lead is now 410.
Full and outside off, QdK comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, spits sharply from the rough, Quinton misses his defense and the ball hits his counterpart.
Full and outside off, de Kock lunges and defends.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Landed on middle and leg. Faf goes back and looks to work but misses and is hit on the pads.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Paddles this fine for another run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR MORE! Short and outside off, de Kock goes back and plays a late cut past backward point for another boundary.
Comes down the track, but is not to the pitch of the ball and somehow defends it to the off side.
FOUR! THE LEAD CROSSES 400! Short and outside off, wide as well, de Kock goes back and cuts it behind point for a boundary. Moves to 21 from 31 balls with his second boundary.
Full and outside off, de Kock looks to sweep but misses.

FOUR! Nice use of the feet. Advances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes it through the covers for a boundary. The stand is worth 40 from 56 balls. Faf moves to 32 from 41 balls.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point.
Floated outside off, driven straight to cover.
Tossed up on middle, de Kock comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Short and outside off, du Plessis goes back and punches it through the covers.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.

NOT OUT. FOUR OVERTHROWS instead. Du Plessis works this through mid-wicket and sets off for a single. He is sent back and the fielder returns a direct hit at the striker's end. They appeal for a run out and it is referred upstairs. Replays show that Faf is back in his crease. Later, we all come to know that the ball has gone to the fine leg fence as suddenly, the scoreboard shoots up by four runs.
The square leg umpire has referred a run out appeal at the striker's end against du Plessis upstairs.
"AIYYYOOOO!" shouts Chandimal. Full and around off, QdK looks to flick but gets a leading edge which goes wide of cover. A run taken.
Tossed up outside off, Quinton leans and drives it to point.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a well-run couple.
Full and around off, de Kock looks top work it through the leg side but gets a leading edge to cover.
Landed outside off, FdP goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge to point.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Good variation in pace, slows this down, tosses this one on middle, defended watchfully.
Outside of, Faf goes back and eases it to cover.
Floated outside off, du Plessis comes down the track and drives it straight to short cover.
Full and wide outside off, eased behind point for a couple.
Fuller on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for another single. Moves to 20 from 28 balls.
Down the leg side, worked straight to leg slip.
Full and around off, driven through mid off for one. 300 UP FOR SOUTH AFRICA.
Short and around off, worked through mid-wicket for a run. The lead touches 380.
On middle, worked to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, de Kock lunges to defend but misses.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for one. The stand is worth 20 from 32 balls.
Full and around off, Quinton comes down the track and flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, spins in, de Kock looks to push it through the off side but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up on middle, Faf comes down the track and eases it to long on for a run.
Landed around off, punched straight to cover.
On the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
That's hit the batsman on his pads.
Down the leg side, du Plessis misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Full and wide again, driven through the covers for a run.
Full and wide outside off, slapped through the covers for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

STUMPING MISSED! FOUR BYES! Not that it would have mattered much but at least it would have lifted the team's spirits. Tossed up outside off, de Kock comes down the track and looks to drive but the ball spins in, goes past the bat and then the stumps. Dinesh Chandimal behind is in a hurry to whip off the bails and misses the ball. Off it goes to the fine leg fence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Hmmmm.... thrown up around off, de Kock looks to flick but gets a bit of a leading edge back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Tossed up wider outside off, driven straight to extra cover.
Full and around off, defended off the inside edge to the leg side.
FOUR! THRASH! He is not going to miss out on those. A short ball on off, de Kock pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, defended towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played the square drive.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Outside off, worked through fine leg for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Goes back in his crease and blocks again.
Comes down the track and blocks.
Pushes this towards the bowler.
Full and around off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Full on middle and off, pushed through the covers for a single.
QUINTON DE KOCK walks in at number 7, replacing Bavuma.

OUT! Caught at bat-pad! Second wicket for de Silva in the space of 7 balls. Tossed up around middle and leg, Bavuma leans to flick but the ball goes off the inside edge, hits him on the pads and goes to short leg where Kusal Mendis completes the formalities. Wow. This is interesting. ULTRA EDGE does not detect any edge. Perhaps Bavuma did hit it because he did not even wait to think for a review. Just walked off. South Africa are effectively 358/5.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run. The stand moves to 10 from 11 balls.
Whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg, Bavuma goes back and works it to the leg side for a couple.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Uppish, but safe! Lovely loop on that delivery, fuller in length outside off, Bavuma leans and checks his cover drive. Luckily for him, the ball flies between cover and mid off to the boundary. THE LEAD MOVES TO 353.
Goes back and punches it towards cover.
The arm ball around off, Faf punches it towards cover for a single.
On the pads, Bavuma looks to work it by closing the face of his bat but misses it and gets rapped up on the pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
TEMBA BAVUMA walks in at number 6, replacing Duminy.

OUT! What a catch by Mathews! Served outside off, Duminy prods forward in defence, expecting the ball to slide in with the angle but the ball straightens a touch and catches the outside edge of his bat towards first slip. Angelo Mathews present there gets low towards his right and takes a superb catch. Duminy's short stint is over! First wicket of the match for de Silva! SOUTH AFRICA WITH A LEAD OF 348 RUNS!
On the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Sliding away, defended off the back foot towards covers for a single.

GREAT DELIVERY! Tossed up outside off, spins in sharply from the rough, surprises Duminy who gets back in the crease looking to punch it but gets off the inside edge through both his legs. That will create doubts in the batsmen's minds!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, du Plessis drives it through covers for another single.
On the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Full outside off, powerfully driven through covers for a single.
Comes down the track and whips it to long on for a single.
RANGANA HERATH is back on.

Shortish delivery, sliding away from the right hander, Faf punches it off the back foot to covers and takes off for a quick single. The fielder present there has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. The batsmen run through for an overthrow as the ball races towards deep mid-wicket. Two runs overall!
Flatter delivery, punched off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Whipped away! Duminy charges down, converts the ball into a full toss and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for another quick single. When these two are out in the middle, one expects them to be busy and take such quick singles.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to covers for another quick single.
Served around leg, Faf leans into the on drive and gets it past the diving short mid-wicket through to long on for a single.
On the pads, defended on the leg side.
Full outside off, Duminy unleashes his exquisite cover drive but sadly finds the man at covers.
Pitched full outside off, driven through widish mid off for a single.
Full outside off, left alone.
Back of a length delivery, pulled through mid-wicket for a brace.
Full around off, Duminy defends it late near the practice pitches in covers for a quick single.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full toss outside off, cut away but straight to point.
Goes back and blocks.
Full and around off, defended back to the bowler.
Skipper FAF DU PLESSIS comes in at number 5, replacing Cook.

OUT! The centurion departs! He was flirting with danger, got lucky earlier but now has to pay the price! Length delivery outside off, Cook in his typical fashion gets across and looks to run it down but misjudges the bounce as the ball catches the outside edge and goes straight in the gloves of Chandimal. The Lankans start celebrating and Cook takes off immediately. Doesn't wait for the umpire's call. Nonetheless, it was a great innings which has taken South Africa in a position of substance with a LEAD OF 326!
Bye! Down the leg side, JP leaves it alone. Chandimal behind the stumps dives to his left but fails to grab the ball. The batsmen run through for a bye!
Length delivery outside off, Cook gets across and cuts through point for a single.
Length delivery, defended into the ground by getting on his toes.
Length delivery outside off, Cook looks to drive it on the up but is late into the shot and gets beaten past the outside edge.
Outside off, Duminy looks to drive but ends up slicing it through point for a single.
Spinning into the pads from outside off, Cook leans ahead and works it with the spin towards square leg. No run taken!
Spinning away from the southpaw, played gently with the spin towards covers for a quick single.
Tossed up around off, Cook reverse sweeps it through point for a single.
Comes from over the wicket for Cook, lands it on middle and off, defended to square leg.
On middle and leg, Duminy clears his front leg and drives it to long off for a single.
Served fuller around off, defended straight back.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA is back on!
Length delivery outside off, Cook stays in the crease and guides it towards gully where a good diving effort from the fielder present there gives away no runs.
Full outside off, Cook leans into the shot and pushes it to mid off.
Short delivery, angling away, a controlled pull through front of square on the leg side for a single.
Once again Duminy plays it back to the bowler.
Length delivery, defended off the back foot back to the bowler.
Short delivery angling down leg, SC gets across and tucks it from near his chest towards deep backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Just a punch! Length delivery, angling away. Duminy uses the angle beautifully as he gets back and punches it through covers for his first boundary of the innings.
Outside off, another gentle push towards covers for a quick single.
Banged in short and angling in, Cook ducks under it.
Angling across the southpaw, steered with soft hands towards backward point region for a quick single. Good running!
Length delivery, angling away, Duminy defends it with the angle on the off side.
Fuller around off, Cook shuffles across and plays it with soft hands towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside leg, JP looks to work it on its way but misses.
Back of a length delivery, directed towards the body, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Outside off, driven to mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Cook punches it towards gully.
On the pads, tickled round the corner for a single.
Outside off, tapped to point for a single.

Fuller on middle and leg, Duminy drives through covers for a brace. As Duminy connected the shot there was a sound off the pads and Pradeep started appealing but the umpire turned it down. The sound maybe was of the bat brushing the pads on its way.
Length delivery with width on offer, cut through point for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Cook pushes through the mid off region. The short cover fielder cuts across by running towards his right.
Length delivery outside off, driven to covers.
Outside off, angling away, Duminy reaches for it and steers it through covers for a single.
Straying on the pads, Duminy looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
NUWAN PRADEEP to continue.
Length delivery, angling across, Duminy taps it with soft hands towards covers and gets off the mark.
Full on middle, driven to mid off.
Fullish on middle and leg, angling away, defended on the leg side.
Fuller around leg, defended solidly with a straight bat.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Cook hops across and punches it through covers for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Cook watches it till the very end and defends it late.

JP DUMINY has walked in the middle to partner the centurion, Stephen Cook. These two like the previous partnership will look to add some quick runs, taking the lead past 400 and then giving their bowlers ample of time to bowl out the visitors. Dushmantha Chameera to continue his spell. Can Amla's wicket lift Sri Lanka's spirit? Let's find out...
... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

The Proteas will be happy with this. It is almost like business as usual. Get a good lead and then build on it. They might have just one thought to ponder now - When to declare. They should be getting somewhere close to 400 in terms of the lead if they play this session out. They have a huge amount of time left, but then if they look at the forecast, they might be tempted to declare earlier than normal. Join us back at 1950 IST (1420 GMT) for the final session. We will be going home late tonight. 29 overs left.

Nothing spectacular for Sri Lanka. They just went through the motions, just waiting for something to happen. The ball is not moving and run-scoring seems to be pretty easy. Nothing on the pitch. Amla gave a chance early on but de Silva failed to grab it.

End of a longggggggggggggggggggg session. 182/2 in 40 overs. All South Africa's. Elgar threw his wicket away while Amla missed a straight one, trying to be a bit cheeky. But the bottom line is that the lead has crossed 300.

OUT! LBW NUMBER 10,000 IN TESTS! What a moment for Pradeep. Not quite sure he will be too focussed with the milestone but at least he has got a wicket. Full and straight, Amla shuffles across and misses his flick. Pradeep appeals as the ball hits his pads and umpire Oxenford raises his finger! Amla has a chat with Oxenford, not quite sure what for and then walks off. A superb knock. To come out of form with an innings like that. That will be TEA ON DAY 3, SOUTH AFRICA LEAD BY 302!
FOUR! THAT TAKES THE LEAD PAST 300. Amla shuffles across his stumps, gets a length ball around off and tickles it to the fine leg fence.
NO BALL. A beautiful delivery though. On a good length around off, Amla looks to defend but is squared up and the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Outside off, left alone.
Goes back in his crease and blocks.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
WIDE. A bouncer, dug in way too short, Amla ducks. 100-RUN STAND COMES UP IN 108 BALLS. Solid run-rate.
A short ball on middle, tucked through square leg for a single.

Full and outside off, pushed through point for a single. 13 from the over, Chameera gets his half century in just 6 overs. Perhaps the team management would have liked it more if he had done it with the bat. Well, he has got one more innings with the willow. Unless South Africa do what Gujarat did recently in the Ranji Trophy quarter-final against Odisha.

FOUR! A bit of an edge but as of now, the slips look like standing a kilometre behind. Full and outside off, Cook pushes forward but the ball goes off the outside edge, wide of first slip and to the third man fence. Would not have carried to second slip.
A short ball around off, pulled with total control through square leg for a run.
The batsman does well to stand tall and play that short delivery. They pick up a single.
3rd Test Century for Stephen Cook!

There it is! Triple figures for Cook. A gift from Pradeep to a guy who is on 99, almost telling him, please take this century and declare. A short ball around middle and leg, Cook works it through square leg and gets a couple. The crowd raises as one to applaud the young guy. His last 4 innings scores read - 40, 104, 59 and as of now, 101 unbeaten.

FOUR! FLAMBOYANT! Moves to 99! Full and around middle and off, Cook drives this straight down the ground. Angelo Mathews gives it a solid chase from mid off, running like a panther chasing its prey, slides near the boundary but is unable to even get a hand to the ball.
DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA is back on.
A short ball outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.

NO BALL, FOUR LEG BYES! Ahh.... Cook was nervously looking at the umpire. Perhaps he hoped that the umpire will not signal leg byes. Full and down the leg side, Cook misses his flick and the ball goes past the keeper to the fine leg fence. 200 UP FOR SOUTH AFRICA. The stand is worth 84 from 99 balls. The lead is now 281.
Landed around off, SC gets across and punches it ala Faf du Plessis style through point for a couple.
He is standing on off stump and works this through mid on for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Full and outside off, Stephen works it through mid-wicket and hares back for a couple. That takes him into the 90s. NO BALL signalled for overstepping. Got a fair way over there, Pradeep. Ahh.... replays show Kusal Mendis throwing the ball from the deep, JUST OVER Aleem Dar at square leg! Kusal Mendis was like Ohhhh while Dar managed a smile. Who says only batsmen need to duck?
Landed outside off, Cook gets across and defends it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, defended towards cover.
Outside off, dabbed with an open face of the bat past first slip for a couple.
This time he stays back and works it to the leg side for a run. The stand is worth 70 from 93 balls.
Full and wide outside off, Stephen gets in a big bat lift and drives it straight to cover.
Comes down the track and pushes it to long on for a single. Moves to 40 from just 43 balls.
Full and down the leg side, Cook misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads to short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Outside off, Amla guides it on the bounce towards slip where Angelo Mathews dives to his right to stop.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On middle and leg, Amla flicks it through mid-wicket. A fielder races to his left and slides near the ropes to prevent the boundary. Three runs taken.
Short and outside off, Amla punches this off the back foot through the covers for a couple.
Landed outside off, left alone.
NUWAN PRADEEP is brought back into the attack!
Goes back and works it through mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, a solid forward defense towards cover.
Landed around off, blocked from the crease.
Landed outside off, pushed with soft hands towards cover.
Pushes this through mid on for a single.
Full and around middle, defended watchfully.
Landed outside off, Cook gently plays the reverse sweep past first slip for a couple.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Goes back and works it fine for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Landed on middle, worked straight to square leg.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
50-run stand for the 3rd wicket between Amla and Cook!

FOUR! Good effort from Chameera. SC paddles it through fine leg and the ball almost reaches the ropes but Dushmantha Chameera giving it a good chase from fine leg, dives to stop the ball but cannot prevent the boundary.
Down the leg side, Stephen misses his flick.
Flicks this towards fine leg for a run.
Goes back and works it past short leg for a single.
Full and down the leg side, flicked straight to short leg.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Goes back and works it through square leg for one.
Full on middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Landed on middle, Cook works it towards backward square leg.
Works it through square leg for a run.
Short and around middle, Cook gets across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
DHANANJAYA de SILVA is introduced into the attack!
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
The batsman plays a sweep shot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman tried to sweep that one but missed it and was hit on the pads.
Cook stays in the crease and blocks it near the surface.
Full and down the leg side, Cook looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the gloves.
Short ball outside off, fended behind square on the off side for a quick single. He will retain the strike!
Gets across and works it wide of mid on. Rangana Herath gives it a good chase and keeps the batsmen to a couple.
Drives this wide of mid off and takes a quick single.
FOUR! FANTASTIC! Amla has played a gem of a knock so far. On a length outside off, Amla stands tall and just punches it through the covers for a boundary.
WIDE! The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper. The square leg umpire signals it as a wide for height!
Landed on off and outside, defended solidly.
Works it to the leg side to raise the 150 UP FOR SOUTH AFRICA.
Full and outside off, eased through mid off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, pushed down to long on for a run.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Around off, watchfully defended from the crease.

FOUR! FABULOUS! He is back - the mighty Hash. Full and around off, delivered from wide of the crease, Amla, with minimum trigger movement, just drives it straight back down the ground. Fetch the ball back please.
Around middle, worked straight to mid on.
Full and outside off, good pace but nothing other than that, left alone.
On a good length outside off, Amla shoulders arms.
DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA is back on!

Down the leg side, whipped straight to short leg where Kusal Mendis is late to react. The ball hits his knees and deflects to fine leg. Purists can count that as a dropped chance, our scorers are not so inhuman. A single taken.
Full and around middle, defended towards point.
Outside off, pushed awkwardly to the off side for a run.
Full and just around off, watchfully defended.
Now he comes down the track and whips it to long on for a single.
Down the leg side, Amla stays back and defends.

DRINKS BREAK. Excellent passage of play for the hosts. Just as they would have wanted. A good batting practice. The only negative aspect - Elgar not converting his half centuries into bigger ones. Meanwhile, some hammering is going on around the lading area of the bowlers. We are ready now.

Angling into the pads, Cook shuffles and tucks off his thigh pad towards fine leg. Good presence of mind by Cook and Amla as they run through quickly for the second. The throw from the deep is at the striker's end where Chandimal collects it and has a shy at the other end end. However, he misses his throw and there is no one backing up for it. The ball goes through towards the long on region and the batsmen run another couple for overthrow. A total of four runs taken!
Outside off, Cook once again opts to not have a go at it.
Wide outside off, Cook covers his stumps and lets it go through.

Full outside off, Amla shuffles across a touch and drives it to mid off and looks to take on the man present there. However, the fielder misses his shy at the non-striker's end and Amla is home safely. One run taken!
Full outside off, the batsman leaves it.
Length delivery outside off, punched through cover-point by Cook in his typical fashion for a single.
Mathews is slowly trudging off the field. He was going at a relatively slow pace. Not quite sure what might have happened. Might be a niggle, might be to just take a break from the proceedings.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Outside off, Stephen somehow manages to block it to the off side.
Goes back and works it behind square leg for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through to long on for a single.
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot to covers.

NOT OUT! Decision stands! Angling into the pads, Cook shuffles across and looks to work it with the angle but misses and gets struck high on the pads. Lakmal starts appealing straightaway but is turned down by the umpire. He is confident and asks Mathews to take the review and he does. The Ball Tracker shows that the ball was going high over the leg stump making the original decision stand. Sri Lanka have one review left.
Mathews has taken the review for an lbw decision against Cook given not out!
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Outside off, left alone.
Back of a length outside off, width on offer, Cook looks to slap it but gets a bottom edge into the ground.

DROPPED! Full outside off, drawing Cook into the cover drive and he obliges but gets an outside edge. The ball flies towards gully. De Silva present there dives low and forward to take the catch but ends up dropping it. Such chances should be taken if they want to get back into the game.
Outside off, played to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the pads, tickled round the corner for a single.
Flatter and shortish outside off, punched through covers for a couple.
FOUR! Use of the feet! Positive intent straightaway! Tossed up around off, Amla dances down the track, doesn't get to the pitch of the ball but manages to loft it over mid on for a boundary.
On middle and leg, defended to short leg.
Back of a length delivery outside off once again, Cook once again shuffles and edges it into the ground and towards gully.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Amla gets across and punches through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Sweetly driven! Full outside off, driven through covers for a boundary. Gets off the mark in style! The lead is now in excess of 200!
Outside off, left alone.
Length delivery outside off, Amla looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball rises onto him as he defends it towards point removing his top hand.
HASHIM AMLA walks out in the middle!

OUT! Lakmal strikes and gets the breakthrough! Back of a length delivery outside off, angling in, Elgar goes for the pull but doesn't get into the perfect position for pulling it. Ends up miscuing it high in the air towards the mid-wicket region. Mathews from mid on runs in the direction of the ball, places himself under it and calmly takes it. Once again Lakmal is the one who strikes for the Lankans! That's the end of 116-run partnership!
No run.
Fired in on middle, nudged to the leg side.
Floated on the pads, steps out and clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Elgar gets across to flick. Misses and is struck on the pads. Loud appeal for lbw but impact was well outside the line.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Floated on middle and leg, pushes at it but gets an inside edge behind square on the leg side for a single.
Pitched up outside off, Elgar blocks it off the front foot.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Cook covers his stumps and defends.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
On the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a brace.
Length delivery outside off, cut through cover-point for a single.
SURANGA LAKMAL is back on!
Cook stays in crease and defends it late with a straight bat.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the delivery before this, Elgar brought up his 4th Test fifty!
Outside off, pushed through covers for a brace.

Spinning into the southpaw, DE clips it to short leg. The short leg fielder, who goes for a direct hit seeing Elgar out of his crease but misses. The batsmen run for the overthrow. This brings up half century for Elgar!
Landed outside off, Elgar leans ahead but misses and gets hit on the pads. There's a mild appeal but it's turned down.
Tossed up outside off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Cook gets across and steers past gully for a boundary.
3rd Test fifty for Cook!
FOUR! What a way to bring another half century in the match! Length delivery outside off, punched through cover-point for a boundary!

Appeal from the bowler! Pitched on a length in the channel of uncertainty, Cook looks to defend it in his typical style by getting across but gets beaten. Pradeep is excited and starts appealing but doesn't get any support from his teammates.
Back of a length delivery, Cook shuffles across and awkwardly taps it towards gully.
Length delivery outside off, guided into the ground and towards the slip cordon.
Tossed up outside off, Elgar drives it through covers but it gets stopped by a diving effort from the fielder present there. Elgar will have to wait for his fifty!
On the pads, Cook comes across and clips it through behind square on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up around off, Cook prods forward in defence.
Touch shortish outside off, Elgar camps back and guides it through the third man region and earns three runs for it. Moves to 49!
Again on the pads, flicked on the leg side.
Spinning into the southpaw, clipped with the spin to mid-wicket.
Length delivery, angling across, played with the angle to point for a single.
Full and wide outside off, an easy leave for Elgar.
Full on off, driven to mid off.
Pitched on the stumps, DE defends it late and into the ground.
Angling across Elgar, he leaves it alone.
Length delivery on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Cook gets down the track a touch and drives it on the full through the gap between mid off and covers for a boundary! Moves to 46!
Full around off, driven to mid off.
This time Cook stays in his crease and defends off the back foot.
Flatter one outside off, Cook prods forward in defence.
Fuller outside off, played to covers. No runs taken!
Tossed up outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Wide outside off, Cook doesn't flirt with it.
Outside off and on a length taped to cover-point for a single.
Length delivery, Cook shuffles across and works it with soft hands towards mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched on a length outside off, guided towards gully.
Outside off, Cook shoulders his arms to let that through.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to backward point.
Spinning into the pads, flicked with the spin to mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, SC gets on his front foot and defends it on the leg side by closing the face of his bat. A quick single taken!
Outside off, defended off the front foot.
Flatter and quicker around middle and leg, Cook charges down and clips through backward square leg for a brace.
Served fuller outside off, Cook prods forward in defence.
Tossed up on middle, Cook prods forward and defends it on the leg side.
Full outside off, blocked from near the surface.
Full outside off, Elgar covers his stumps and leaves it.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Fullish delivery angling away, Elgar pokes at it away from his body but gets beaten as the ball moves away a touch.
Outside off, angling away, left alone.
The players are out in the middle. Nuwan Pradeep to continue his over.
UPDATE 1730 IST - Play will resume at 1735 IST. According to the revised timings, Tea will be taken at 1930 IST.

The drizzle has got heavier and the umpires have instructed the players to leave the field. Doesn't look dark out there at all. In fact, seems to be getting brighter at a distance. Could be a passing shower. We'll keep you updated.
Short of a length on leg stump, Cook gets across to flick but the ball flies off the glove down to fine leg for a single.
Loopy on a length outside off, stays back and defends it to short leg.
Flatter on a length outside off, Elgar stays back and defends it to short leg.
Drifting in from outside off, reaches out to that one and smothers it to the ground.
Floated outside off, Elgar presses well forward to block but is hit on the pads. Impact well outside the line as there is a muted lbw shout.
Drifting in from around off, Elgar pushes at it but gets an edge that goes on the bounce to first slip.
Tossed up around off, whipped back to the bowler.
RANGANA HERATH comes on to bowl.
Back of a length outside off, steered off the back foot through point for a single.
Full and just outside off, Cook shoulders arms to that one.
Full on middle and leg, Cook gets across and tucks it to square leg for a single.
Fuller on the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length angled outside off, Elgar hangs back and lets it pass.
NUWAN PRADEEP is back on.
It's started to drizzle but the sun is also out. Let's hope that the sun wins the battle and we don't have any further interruptions.
FOUR! Creamed! Full and wide outside off, Cook reaches out and covers the movement with a fluent drive through the covers for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Cook rides the bounce and fends it well to cover.
Short of a length outside off, Cook hangs back and defends it firmly.
Fuller on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and way too wide outside off, Elgar wouldn't chase that even in a T20I. Wide called.
Good length around off, blocked firmly off the back foot to the off side.
Back of a length wider outside off, shuffles across and steers it to third man for a single.
Forward short leg is in place.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and checks his drive to extra cover.
FOUR! More streaky runs! Length ball slanted across Elgar who pushes hard at it away from the body. Goes off the outer half past gully to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length angled away outside off, Elgar shuffles a bit and shoulders arms to that one.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, Elgar rocks back and blocks it well.
Short of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot through point for a single.
Too straight and easy pickings for Cook, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, Cook gets across and drives it well to mid on.
Fuller on middle, Elgar gets across and tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked on the leg side for a single.
Good length closer to off, Cook defends it solidly from the crease. Almost spooned a return catch to Chameera there.
Good length outside off, Cook makes a leave to that one.
Good length on middle, worked towards mid-wicket. Chameera has overstepped and it's a no ball.
Shortish outside off, Cook blocks it well off the back foot.
Full and outside off, Cook presses forward and bunts it towards mid off.
Length ball wider outside off, blocked firmly off the back foot on to the track.
Back of a length outside off, too wide to make the batsman play.
Length ball outside off, another leave from Cook.
Shortish outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Back of a length on off, Cook looks to flick but gets a leading edge to the off side for a single.
Shortish outside off, hangs back to that one and fends it to cover.

FOUR! More luck for Cook! Short ball on middle, he shuffles to pull but isn't in control. The ball flies off the glove and just sails over a leaping Chandimal as it goes to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Good length around off, blocked well from the crease.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Back of a length outside off, Cook stays back and punches it through the covers. Beautifully struck and it raced away to the fence for a boundary.
Good length on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA comes on to bowl.
Full and outside off, leans forward and blocks it well.
Shortish outside off, blocked firmly off the back foot.
FOUR! Edges continue to go safe for the Proteas! Back of a length outside off, shaping away as Cook hangs his bat at it. Gets a thick edge that flies just past third slip to the third man fence.
Length ball but too wide outside off, easy leave for Cook.
Back of a length outside off, Elgar rocks back and steers it to deep point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Elgar leaves it alone to the keeper.
Fuller on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Elgar doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Fuller on middle, Elgar pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Length ball around off, nips in a touch as Cook prods forward. Gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Cook shuffles across and makes an awkward leave.
Short of a length outside off, Elgar stands tall and punches it serenely through the covers for a brace.
Back of a length around off, Cook shuffles across and rides the bounce to work it towards short mid-wicket for a quick single.
Good length angled in from outside off, Elgar taps it towards point with soft hands for an easy single.
Drifting on the pads, Cook tucks it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to deep point for a single.
Fuller and angled in from outside off, good leave from Elgar.
SURANGA LAKMAL to bowl from the other end.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot through the covers for a single.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller on off, leans across and pushes it back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, stays back to push at it but gets it off the outer half towards gully.
Beaten! Length ball angled away outside off, Elgar pokes at it but is beaten comprehensively by the away movement.
Good length outside off, no shot offered as the ball barely carries to Chandimal.

Welcome back for the second session. Can the Lankans put up a better show with the ball? Conditions are certainly favorable for the pacers. Their skipper ANGELO MATHEWS to begin proceedings after lunch.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 2.....
UPDATE 1605 IST - Great news, folks! The PLAY WILL RESUME AT 1620 IST! Hope we don't have any further interruptions due to weather.

UPDATE 1550 IST - It's still raining over at St. George's Park but has toned down a bit. There is no news yet on what time the second session will start. As soon as we get any updates on the same, we will keep you posted!

With this halt in play, an EARLY LUNCH has been taken. South Africa would be happier of the two sides going into the break as they ripped through the tail and took a healthy 81-run lead. After surviving some early scares, the Protea openers saw through the session putting 39 runs on board. Can the visitors come up with something strong? Or will the hosts extend their lead? Let's hope that the weather permits us to start the second session on time.
LIGHTNING STOPS PLAY! The players have walked back to their respective dressing rooms as it has started to drizzle over St. George's Park. The ground has been covered. Wait for further updates!
Angling into the pads, worked to square leg for a single.
Length delivery, angling in, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, Elgar shoulders his arms to let that go.
No ball! Angling down leg, Elgar looks to clip but misses. No ball signalled for overstepping.

Length delivery outside off, punched through the gap in covers. Kusal Perera chases it and fields just before the fence. The umpires have a check upstairs and Perera has done well over there. Two runs taken!
Full outside off, Elgar defends it late near the surface.
Outside off, left alone.
Change of ends for NUWAN PRADEEP!
Length delivery on the stumps, defended from within the crease.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
On the pads, clipped away for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, Cook once again shuffles across and defends off the inner half of the bat on the leg side.

Appeal for caught behind! Angling down leg, Cook gets across and looks to tuck it but fails as the ball goes through to the keeper. There's some sound as the ball goes past Cook and the Lankans start appealing but is turned down by the umpire. It's the right decision as the replay shows it brushed the thigh pad on its way.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single. He will keep the strike!
Wide outside off, Cook doesn't have a got at it.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
This time Cook is forced to play as he defends the fullish delivery around off proding forward.
Once again Cook lets it go through to the keeper.
Full outside off, swinging further away, left alone by Cook.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Pitched outside off, Elgar blocks it off the front foot.
Length delivery outside off, defended on the off side.
FOUR! Straight down the ground! Length delivery outside off, Elgar taps it on the bounce past the bowler for a boundary. He has timed as sweetly as he can!
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Length delivery, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
ANGELO MATHEWS replaces Pradeep!
On a length outside off, defended into the ground and towards point.
Outside off, Elgar pushes it gently through covers for a brace.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Pulled away! Back of a length delivery outside off, Elgar latches onto it in a flash as he pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

Edged but dropped short!  Length delivery angling into the southpaw, Elgar looks to defend it with the angle but the ball doesn't come back in as much as he expects and catches the outside edge of the bat but falls short of the man at first slip. Playing with soft hands saved him there!
Outside off, an easy leave for Elgar.

Fullish delivery outside off, Cook gets across and pokes at it awkwardly. Luckily, the ball whizzes past the outside edge and into the keeper's gloves. He is surviving out there currently! Has to be more careful!
Length delivery outside off, pushed to point.
Fuller on the stumps, played with soft hands towards forward square leg, Cook from the other end takes off and Elgar obliges. Quick single taken!
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
On middle, nipping into the pads, Elgar gets on toes and tucks through square leg for a couple. The lead is now over 100 runs!
On the pads, defended with a straight bat.
Outside off, Cook lets the ball come close to him and then opens the face of his bat to steer it towards point.
On middle and leg, defended on the leg side off the back foot.
Full outside off, Elgar leans into the drive through mid off for three runs.
On the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, swinging away, defended from within the crease.
Outside off, shaping away, left alone.
Good length on leg stump, worked towards square leg.
Length ball outside off, Elgar lets it pass to the keeper.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball on off, blocked solidly from the crease by taking the bottom hand off the bat.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends well.

FOUR! Streaky runs! SL are bowling well but aren't quite getting the luck. Length ball outside off, Elgar pokes at it with an angled bat. Played with soft hands as the edge flies between third slip and gully to the fence.
Fuller on the pads, flicked away on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Elgar shuffles across to flick but is hit on the thigh.
Fuller outside off, Elgar leans into it and defends solidly.
Length ball around off, Elgar pushes at it but is beaten.
Fuller around off, Elgar gets across and pats it back to the bowler.
Back of a length around off, left alone to the keeper.
Played well in the end! Back of a length on off, climbs on Cook who fends awkwardly from the crease. Manages to keep the ball on the ground.
Good length angled in from outside off, Cook shuffles and lifts his bat to let it pass.
Length ball outside off, Pradeep's line is just a tad wide to make the batsman play.
Good length outside off, another comfortable leave for Cook.
Too wide outside off, easy leave for Cook.
Good length outside off, Cook continues to be nervy as he pushes tentatively at it. Gets an edge again through the slip cordon for a brace.
NUWAN PRADEEP to share the new ball.
Good length closer to off, blocked firmly from the crease.
Good length on middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a brace.
Length ball outside off, Elgar blocks it awkwardly from the crease.
Good length on middle, Cook pushes at it but gets a thick inside edge on to the pads. They take a quick single.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.

FOUR! Almost a wicket! Fuller on leg stump, Cook shuffles to play across the line but gets a thick leading edge. Just flies between a diving third slip and gully to the third man fence. Encouraging start for the Lankans.
